def recursive_solve(ones, n, index):
    q = n // ones[index]
    n %= ones[index]
    used = q * index
    if n == 0:
        return used
    else:
        option1 = recursive_solve(ones, n, index - 1)
        option2 = index + recursive_solve(ones, ones[index] - n, index - 1)
        return used + min(option1, option2)

n = int(input())
ones = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1

answer = recursive_solve(ones, n, 16)
print(answer)
